src: Batch 2 town expansion layout (planner, 2026-11-09). Brief v2 §3 neighbourhood expansion, §13a places and attractions, §14, §15 decision 18 (the approval map) and the rides-versus-minigames rule; BUILD_PLAN §3.16-§3.18, W3b #7, #13, #14, W3c #15-#20, invariant 4. Placements surveyed against the baked town (build/Town.rbxm), build/Attractions.rbxm, generated/Lots, Roads, Wildlife trees and the harvested routes. Spec: docs/waves/BATCH2_SPEC.md.
frame: Per venue: origin = footprint centre on the finished floor (floorY). Local X across the frontage, Y up, D into the building from the front (front face at D = -d/2). The front faces world (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw): facing +Z yaw 0, -Z pi, +X pi/2, -X -pi/2. World = Shared/Attractions/AlleyLayout.toWorld({x, z, floorY, yaw}, X, Y, D). footprint {w, d} is the building; site {x0, x1, d0, d1} (local) is everything the venue builds (yards, patios, courts, lots). floorY = highest ground under the footprint + 0.5 (lawns: the highest ground); ground {min, max} tells the builder how deep the plinth or skirt must go.
